answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 43486 Country: Pakistan Title: Reciting the holy Quran without Wudhu Question: As stated in Quran; it is surely the Noble Qur'an (recorded already) in a protected book [the Preserved Tablet] that is not touched except by the purified ones. Can we recite the holy Quran from computer without wudhu? Answer ID: 43486 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 282/182/L=1434) You can recite the holy Quran on computer without wudhu. However it shall not be lawful to touch the screen when the Quranic verses are visible on it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
